note: Both sets cover the same core plumbing/equipment facts correctly (BRIZO faucets by tag, FRANKE sink, TOTO watercloset, hood fan and dishwasher locations, WB profile, PT1 tile size) and both repeat the F10 patio side table rows under two different entity names. Set A additionally captures the F10 quantities for both rows and correctly separates the WB MDF material as a condition, but it truncates the bed dimensions to "3'" and the shower location to "BATHR". Set B invents a second watercloset model claim ("C454CUFG#0" with a fabricated quote), truncates the PT1 description to the vague "PORCELAIN", and adds trivial claims (Bed description = BED, schedule scale), so it has more wrong claims overall.
remarks: Both sets state the F10 patio side table facts twice, once as 'PATIO SIDE TABLE (F10)' and once as 'F10 PATIO SIDE TABLE (S/2)' — a recurring duplicate-under-two-names pattern. The furniture schedule's F10 tag spans two dimension rows (1'-3 1/2" cube and 1'-1 1/2" cube, qty 2 each); calling them 'option 1/option 2' is an interpretation not stated on the page. Both sets truncate the shower valve/head location (page reads 'BATHROOM SHOWER') and use the vague entity 'Shower'. Important facts both sets miss: TV size 40", quartz countertop spec (Caesarstone Pure White, eased edge, 1-3/16"), paint/trim colour specs, glass (tempered 1/2"), laminate plank and VCT floor finishes, and nearly all furniture and millwork dimensions.
